rag.name: baggage allowance query
rag.query: how much baggage can I bring for free

corpus.text: Baggage allowance: one carry-on and one checked bag up to 23kg are included free.
Carry-on rules: one personal item plus one cabin bag no larger than 55x40x20 cm.
Billing and refund: your refund is processed to the original card within 7 business days.
Cancellation policy: cancel your flight up to 24 hours before departure for a full refund.
Seat selection is complimentary within 24 hours of departure.
Online check-in opens 48 hours before your flight and closes 1 hour before departure.
